american express.disputeEntryPoint: Sign in, open your transaction history, select the charge, and choose 'Dispute this Charge'.
american express.filingWindowNote: Consumers should gather documents before starting the online dispute flow and contact the merchant first when possible.
american express.statusTracking: Monitor the dispute through the Amex account experience after submission.

bank of america.disputeEntryPoint: Start from the credit card dispute area inside Bank of America online banking.
bank of america.filingWindowNote: Before opening the dispute, try to resolve the issue with the merchant and collect documents that support the claim.
bank of america.statusTracking: Track updates inside the online banking dispute workflow.

capital one.disputeEntryPoint: Open the charge details in your Capital One account and follow the online dispute prompts.
capital one.filingWindowNote: Capital One advises reviewing the transaction details, contacting the merchant first, and gathering documentation before filing.
capital one.statusTracking: Customers can generally review dispute status through their online account experience.

chase.disputeEntryPoint: Start from the transaction details in your Chase card account or contact Chase disputes support.
chase.filingWindowNote: Chase recommends contacting the merchant first and collecting supporting documents before disputing.
chase.statusTracking: Status may be reviewed through Chase account channels once the dispute is opened.

citi.disputeEntryPoint: Begin the investigation through Citi servicing channels after gathering the transaction details and dispute basis.
citi.filingWindowNote: Citi explains that disputes may result in provisional credit during the investigation, depending on the case.
citi.statusTracking: Customers should monitor the case through Citi servicing communications and account updates.

wells fargo.disputeEntryPoint: Use Wells Fargo account servicing options for transaction help and dispute initiation.
wells fargo.filingWindowNote: Customers should review the posted transaction, attempt merchant resolution when appropriate, and keep supporting documents ready.
wells fargo.statusTracking: Check for updates through account servicing and dispute follow-up communications.
